blurb: Blue Devil Golf Club offers an 18-hole golf course with dynamic pricing based on day, time, and demand. They provide private and group golf lessons with PGA professionals, host tournaments and group events, and have indoor golf simulators available in the off-season. Power carts are available for rent with age and license requirements.
